briefing: Stocks fell across the board today: the NASDAQ dropped 1.2% and the S&P 500 dropped 1.3%. The screener returned no candidates, so there were no qualifying buys. I'm holding all seven positions and keeping the $546 in cash for a better entry, and the automatic stop-losses and profit targets stay in place to manage risk.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-off day is when investors get nervous and sell riskier assets like growth stocks, usually moving money into safer places such as cash or bonds. On these days most stocks fall together, so buying new positions is riskier because the selling may continue. Holding cash and waiting for the market to calm down can protect you from buying just before prices fall further.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險模式」（Risk-Off）是指投資者情緒轉趨審慎，紛紛拋售成長股等高風險資產，並將資金轉投現金或債券等較安全的資產。在這類交易日，大部分股票往往同步下跌，此時貿然建倉風險較高，因為沽壓或會持續。手持現金、靜待市況回穩，可避免在股價進一步下跌前高位接貨。

market_education.summary_en: Both major U.S. indexes fell more than 1% today. Because the drop was spread across the market and not limited to one sector, it points to investors pulling back from risk in general rather than reacting to news about one company. No news headlines were included in today's data, so this summary cannot tie the move to a specific cause.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面受壓，納斯達克指數下跌1.2%，標普500指數跌1.3%，兩大指數同告失守1%關口。跌勢遍及大市而非集中於個別板塊，反映投資者整體避險情緒升溫，而非針對單一企業消息作出反應。由於今日數據未附相關新聞標題，本文無法將跌勢歸因於特定消息。
